summary: Iter166 backend regression after Customer Android package rename to app.azoapp.homeservice. All 10 tests passed. Verified public /api/app-mgmt/config/{customer,partner} return correct apk_package values, admin GET returns both platforms, admin PUT /admin/config/customer saves and public GET reflects the changes (latest_version=1.6.0, version_code=16, update_enabled=true), and flags were reset to false at the end so preview app is not blocked. Live Logs (POST /api/logs/client + admin GET /admin/logs, /summary, /health) all healthy. Admin OTP login + /admin/dashboard regression OK.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/app_management_routes.py L173 falls back to EXPECTED_PACKAGE[platform] when apk_package is empty; that behaviour is what allowed customer public config to return 'app.azoapp.homeservice' even without an uploaded APK — good, keep it.

Admin PUT /admin/config/{platform} performs partial upsert without validating field types beyond version_code + booleans; consider a Pydantic model to guard against arbitrary keys leaking into app_config.
seed_data_creation: None. PUT test snapshots current customer config, applies test payload, then resets update_enabled/force_update/maintenance_enabled to false and restores latest_version/version_code from snapshot.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite for App Management + Live Logs lives at /app/backend/tests/test_app_mgmt_pkg_iter166.py (extends iter165). Confirms customer package is app.azoapp.homeservice and partner is app.azoapp.partner. Safe to re-run — final PUT resets flags.
